contract.label: Phone input
contract.summary: A phone number field whose country selector keeps the dial code and the number in a single value.

parts.name: PhoneInput
parts.description: The composed field — country selector plus number entry.

props.name: surface
props.description: What the field sits on — default inside a card, sheet, dialog or table row, where the number entry rests clear so the surface shows through; page straight on the shell's muted content area, where it and the extension take the outline Button's face, level with the country trigger.

rules: **Pick the surface by what is underneath.** A phone field placed straight on the shell's `muted` content area takes `surface="page"`, which gives the number entry and the extension the outline Button's face, level with the country trigger. Inside a `card`, `sheet`, `dialog` or table row it keeps `default`.
antiPatterns: A field on the muted page body given `bg-background`, `bg-card` or `bg-white` instead of `surface="page"` — in dark mode `background` is darker than `card`, so the field sinks below the cards beside it.
